sideline.title: Choosing QuePaxa, an unusual consensus algorithm
sideline.summary: Cloudflare is building an experimental consensus service using a never-before-deployed consensus algorithm, QuePaxa. In this post we explain how QuePaxa works and why we chose it.

sideline.title: Introducing Spend Management: Spending limits and alerts for Cloudflare
sideline.summary: Spend Management adds opt-in spending caps for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, and more products soon. Here is how we built the metering pipeline that turns usage into runtime decisions.

sideline.title: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model
sideline.summary: AI-orchestrated penetration testing platforms like ARTEX have become increasingly powerful tools enabling effective attacks on exposed infrastructure. Here we share Cloudflare’s observations and recommended countermeasures.

sideline.title: Kitesurf is now open source
sideline.summary: Kitesurf, our experimental browser engine for AI agents, is now open source. Inspect the code, run it locally, or deploy your own instance on Cloudflare Workers.
